camel_example: aliyun gpdb DescribeDBInstancePlans --region cn-hangzhou --PlanCreateDate '2022-04-17T23:00Z' --DBInstanceId 'gp-bp12ga6v69h860000' --PlanScheduleType Regular --PlanId 1234 --PlanType PauseResume --PlanDesc this_is_a_test_plan
description_en: Queries the information about plans for an AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 查看AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例的计划详情
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb describe-db-instance-plans --db-instance-id gp-bp12ga6v69h860000 --plan-desc this_is_a_test_plan --plan-type PauseResume --plan-schedule-type Regular --plan-id 1234 --plan-create-date 2022-04-17T23:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDBInstancePlans

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances within a region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the plan. Valid values:

PauseResume: pauses and resumes an instance.
Resize: scales an instance.
ModifySpec: changes compute node specifications
parameters.help_zh:
计划类型，取值如下：

PauseResume：自动启停。
Resize：节点扩容。
ModifySpec：规格变更，即变更计算节点规格
parameters.name: plan_type

parameters.help_en:
The execution mode of the plan. Valid values:

Postpone: The plan is executed later.
Regular: The plan is executed periodically
parameters.help_zh:
计划执行方式，取值如下：

Postpone：稍后执行。
Regular：周期执行
parameters.name: plan_schedule_type

parameters.help_en:
The plan ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449398.html operation to query the information about plans, including plan IDs
parameters.help_zh:
计划ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449398.html接口查看计划的详细信息，包括计划ID
parameters.name: plan_id

parameters.help_en: The time that is used to filter plans. If you specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format, the plans that are created before this time are returned. The time must be in UTC. If you do not specify this parameter, all plans are returned
parameters.help_zh: 过滤该日期之前创建的计划，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间），不传入该参数表示返回所有时间的计划
parameters.name: plan_create_date

ErrorMessage.description_en:
The error message.

This parameter is returned only if the request fails
ErrorMessage.description_zh:
错误信息。

只会在API执行失败时返回该参数

PlanConfig.description_en: The execution information of the plan

PlanEndDate.description_en:
The end time of the plan. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.



This parameter is returned only for the plans that are periodically executed.

If you did not specify the end time when you created the plan, this parameter is not returned
PlanEndDate.description_zh: 计划的结束时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 仅周期执行的计划返回该参数。 创建计划时该参数不传，则不返回

PlanScheduleType.description_en:
The execution mode of the plan. Valid values:

Postpone: The plan is executed later.
Regular: The plan is executed periodically
PlanScheduleType.description_zh:
计划执行方式，取值如下：

Postpone：稍后执行。
Regular：周期执行

PlanStartDate.description_en:
The start time of the plan. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time is displayed in UTC.



This parameter is returned only for the plans that are periodically executed.

If you did not specify the start time when you created the plan, the current time is returned
PlanStartDate.description_zh: 计划的开始时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 仅周期执行的计划返回该参数。 不传默为当前时间

PlanStatus.description_en:
The status of the plan. Valid values:

active
cancel
deleted
finished
PlanStatus.description_zh:
计划状态，取值如下：

active：运行中。
cancel：取消。
deleted：删除。
finished：执行完成

PlanType.description_en:
The type of the plan. Valid values:

PauseResume: pauses and resumes an instance.
Resize: scales an instance
PlanType.description_zh:
计划类型，取值如下：

PauseResume：自动启停。
Resize：节点扩容，即增加或减少计算节点。
ModifySpec：规格变更，即变更计算节点规格

PageRecordCount.description_en: The number of entries per page

Status.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful.

If the request was successful, success is returned. If the request failed, this parameter is not returned
Status.description_zh:
API执行状态。

执行成功则返回success；执行失败则不返回该参数

TotalRecordCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
